children: XRP's decline appears to be deepening, with net outflows from US spot exchange-traded funds weighing on the token's price.
According to CoinMarketCap, XRP was trading at $0.8688 as of 3:10 p.m. on Nov. 21, down 10.30% from a day earlier.

CoinDesk cited outflows from the spot ETF market and large-scale liquidations in futures as key drivers of XRP's weakness. SoSoValue data showed that US spot XRP ETFs recorded about $4.97 million in net outflows on Nov. 20.

As a result, the combined net assets of five US spot XRP ETFs fell to about $990 million. Cumulative net inflows since launch still total about $1.78 billion, but XRP's price decline has reduced the funds' net assets.

Selling pressure also intensified in the futures market. CoinGlass data showed about $18 million worth of XRP futures positions were liquidated over the past 24 hours. About 94% of that total consisted of long positions betting on price gains.

title: XRP Tumbles 10% in a Day as ETF Outflows Deepen
